exportSummaries.OwnedChain: Which bone chains a motion executor OWNS for the duration of a performance.
exportSummaries.animatedTranslationBoneNames: Extract ANIMATED translation-bone names from a three.js AnimationClip's tracks.
exportSummaries.applyAndPlantSupineOnDeck: One-shot: pose + plant Y + center XZ + re-plant (used at humanoid register).
exportSummaries.applyGeneratedHumanoidClinicalIdlePostur: Apply relaxed standing arm hang + head attention to a loaded humanoid root.
exportSummaries.applyHumanoidJointRotationsByAlias: Apply a role-specific joint map with alias matching + quaternion write.
exportSummaries.applyPosturePose: Apply procedural sit rotations to skinned bones under a loaded humanoid root.
exportSummaries.applySupinePose: Apply procedural recumbent rotations + root Z reorientation.
exportSummaries.applySupinePoseHoldingIncline: Per-frame: re-apply flat on-back basis then restore the register tip quaternion (#171 seam 3).
exportSummaries.boneIsOwned: True when `boneName` appears verbatim in any declared chain.
exportSummaries.collectJointNames: Collect the sanitised bone-name set actually present on a loaded humanoid — scene-graph Bone nodes plus `SkinnedMesh.skeleton.bones` (both are used as authoritative lists by pose code).
exportSummaries.describeRuntimeBundleScenarioMatch: Report when the loaded runtime bundle belongs to a different scenario than the one the learner selected — the #57 silence one layer down (roster/assets).
exportSummaries.findBonesBySanitisedName: Find every object (Bone nodes + skeleton.bones) whose sanitised name matches a target.
exportSummaries.holdSupinePlantFrame: Per-frame plant hold: restore base XZ/Y with mild breathing; root Z owned by applySupinePose.
exportSummaries.measureBackToDeckGap: Signed gap: body back surface vs back-section top plane.
exportSummaries.measureSeatClearanceMeters: Seat-plane clearance via true skinned verts (#150 skinnedWorldAabb family).
exportSummaries.mpfbForearmIdleEuler: MPFB2 idle forearm euler for a given bind — absolute X bend in the bind's own direction.
exportSummaries.plantSeatedPelvisOnSeat: After a seated pose is applied, shift the humanoid root so the pelvis rests on the chair seat (not hovering, not buried).
exportSummaries.readBackSectionPlane: World normal of the back section top (outward from mattress).
exportSummaries.readSupineTorsoWorldDeg: World-space torso axis angle from horizontal (degrees), from pelvis→chest/spine.
exportSummaries.reapplySupineHeadToStoredPillow: After hold restores base XYZ, re-apply head→pillow XZ only (no Y — Y sink undoes seat plant).
exportSummaries.resolveEffectiveVerticalOffsetMeters: Live diagnosis (#72): telehealth actors with feet-near-origin GLBs were placed with the ED-era pairing (slot y≈1.0 + verticalOffset≈-0.95).
exportSummaries.seatedRoleClipIsPlayable: True when `clipName` names a seated-rig performance AND its measured translation channels do not animate root/pelvis/leg bones, so playing it under the #83 seated carve-out cannot fight seated height ownership.
exportSummaries.settleSupineOntoBackSection: Translate the body along the back-section normal so the mesh rests on the raised mattress.
exportSummaries.settleSupineOntoBackSectionPreservingSea: Close back-plane float by sliding in XZ only (pelvis Y / seat plant preserved).
